findings.title: Modified `config` copy is never used; original unmodified config is returned
findings.body: In `get_monitor_environment_context`, a copy of `monitor_environment.monitor.config` is made and its `schedule_type` key is replaced with the human-readable display value. However, the return dict on line 168 uses `monitor_environment.monitor.config` (the original, unmodified dict) instead of the local `config` variable. This means the `schedule_type` modification is dead code and the context sent to Kafka will contain the raw enum value rather than the display string. This is a pre-existing bug carried over from `mark_failed.py`, but since it's being extracted into its own module, it's a good opportunity to fix it by returning `config` instead of `monitor_environment.monitor.config`.
